integrity: All claims are supported by the included algebraic proof, with finite-dimensional calculations used only as corroboration. Scientific limitations are explicit.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the leading-order effective Lindblad generator for a balanced complete-graph, single-excitation network; it does not assert identical multiplicities for the exact finite-step random-unitary channel.
The rank-one endpoint kappa=1, unbalanced groups, and higher-excitation sectors are excluded.
No independent expert audit or exhaustive literature-wide originality certification has been performed.
title: Macroscopic slow-mode degeneracy in correlated quantum-network dissipation
